name: Risk Acceptance Approval Step
description: One step of a risk acceptance's approval chain. Steps with the same sequence are peers; a sequential step waits for every lower sequence, a parallel step waits for nothing.

fields.label: Required Role
fields.description: The role the approver holds. Leave empty for the risk-acceptance approver role.

fields.label: Assignee Source
fields.description: Chosen At Request: whoever asks for approval picks a holder of the role. Named User: always the person named below.
